chill.title: Picnic at Parque Lineal Ciudad del Río
chill.description: Spread a blanket on the lawns beside the modern art museum and watch skaters, dogs and food trucks roll by.
chill.bonus: Bring a frisbee and get a stranger to join one throw.

chill.title: Zócalo Wander Through Guatapé's Plazoleta de los Zócalos
chill.description: Amble through rainbow streets where every house wears hand-painted relief panels telling a story.
chill.bonus: Find a zócalo that matches your job and take a photo in front of it.

chill.title: Barefoot Walk at Parque de los Pies Descalzos
chill.description: Kick off your shoes and walk sand, water and a bamboo grove in a park designed to slow you down.
chill.bonus: Keep your shoes off for the entire visit, no exceptions.

chill.title: Orchid Garden Stroll at Jardín Botánico
chill.description: Drift under the giant wooden Orquideorama canopy and past lagoons full of turtles and iguanas.
chill.bonus: Find the biggest iguana in the garden and give it a name.

chill.title: Dome Show at the Planetario de Medellín
chill.description: Lie back under the dome for a full-sky show, then wander the space exhibits next to Parque de los Deseos.
chill.bonus: Find the constellation of your birth sign during the show and point it out.

chill.title: Aquarium Visit at Parque Explora
chill.description: Lose track of time in Latin America's largest freshwater aquarium inside the city's bold red science museum.
chill.bonus: Find the piranhas and time how long you can stare without blinking.

chill.title: Reading Hour at Biblioteca Pública Piloto
chill.description: Settle into the UNESCO-founded public library and browse its photo archive of old Medellín.
chill.bonus: Find a photo of the street you are staying on from before 1960.

chill.title: Coffee and People Watching in Jardín's Parque Principal
chill.description: Grab a painted wooden chair beneath the neo-Gothic basilica and watch farmers in sombreros trot by on horseback.
chill.bonus: Strike up a conversation with a local at the next table and learn one paisa phrase.

chill.title: Golden Hour at Mirador de Las Palmas
chill.description: Pull over at the lookout on the Las Palmas road and watch the valley lights flicker on at dusk.
chill.bonus: Stay until you can count 100 lights switching on.

chill.title: Afternoon at Casa Museo Otraparte
chill.description: Tour philosopher Fernando González's house museum, then linger with a coffee in its leafy garden.
chill.bonus: Read one page of González aloud to your group in the garden.

foodie.title: Dinner at Elcielo Medellín
foodie.description: Surrender to Juan Manuel Barrientos's theatrical multi-sensory tasting menu at the flagship that launched a Michelin-starred empire.
foodie.bonus: Toast with the edible course and make a wish before eating it.

foodie.title: Paisa Feast at Hato Viejo
foodie.description: Share ajiaco, sancocho and grilled meats in a big rustic dining room on the Las Palmas road.
foodie.bonus: Order one dish nobody at the table can pronounce.

foodie.title: Tamarind Sweets in Santa Fe de Antioquia's Plaza
foodie.description: Escape to the hot colonial town and snack on sticky pulpa de tamarindo from vendors around the whitewashed main square.
foodie.bonus: Buy a sweet from three different vendors and crown the best one.

foodie.title: Exotic Fruit Tasting at Plaza Minorista
foodie.description: Wander the city's busiest market and sample lulo, granadilla, pitahaya and fruits you have no name for.
foodie.bonus: Buy one fruit you have never seen and get the vendor to teach you how to eat it.

foodie.title: Coffee Flight at Pergamino Café Provenza
foodie.description: Taste single-origin Colombian beans side by side on the shaded corner that defines Medellín coffee culture.
foodie.bonus: Order a brew method you have never tried and describe its flavour in three words.

foodie.title: Tasting Menu at Carmen
foodie.description: Eat your way through Colombia's biodiversity in a glass conservatory at one of Latin America's 50 Best.
foodie.bonus: Ask the server which ingredient on the menu is hardest to source and order that dish.

foodie.title: Rose Petal Arequipe at Dulces del Jardín
foodie.description: Sample basil jam, arracacha arequipe and rose petal sweets at a family candy kitchen beloved since 1995.
foodie.bonus: Pick the strangest flavour in the case and make everyone try it.

foodie.title: Sunday Sancocho at Sancho Paisa
foodie.description: Eat the traditional Antioquian cooking that top chef Carmen Ángel calls her favourite, served up on the Las Palmas road.
foodie.bonus: Ask for the grill master's favourite cut and order it without looking at the menu.

foodie.title: Food Hall Crawl at Mercado del Río
foodie.description: Graze through dozens of stalls in a converted warehouse, from ceviche to arepas to craft cocktails.
foodie.bonus: Each person orders from a different stall and the group votes on the winner.

foodie.title: Breakfast Arepas at El Rancherito Las Palmas
foodie.description: Fuel up on a hearty paisa breakfast at a 50 year old roadside favourite on the climb out of the city.
foodie.bonus: Try the hot chocolate with cheese dunked in it, the paisa way.

foodie.title: Mondongo Soup at Mondongo's
foodie.description: Order the tripe soup that made this family restaurant a Medellín institution for nearly five decades.
foodie.bonus: Have the person who has never tried tripe take the first spoonful.

foodie.title: Bandeja Paisa at Hacienda on Junín
foodie.description: Tackle the full bandeja paisa in the original second-floor dining room overlooking the downtown Junín promenade.
foodie.bonus: Finish every last bean and chicharrón on the plate.

social.title: Live Cuban Salsa at Son Havana
social.description: Squeeze onto a packed Laureles dance floor while a Cuban band drives the city's best salsa dancers wild.
social.bonus: Dance one full song with someone you just met.

social.title: Tango Night at Salón Málaga
social.description: Drink a cold beer among jukeboxes and vintage photos while couples of every age dance tango in a bar open since 1957.
social.bonus: Ask a regular to teach you one tango step on the floor.

social.title: Downtown Walking Tour With Real City Tours
social.description: Hear the honest story of Medellín's transformation from a local guide on the city's most famous free walking tour.
social.bonus: Ask your guide one question nobody else in the group dares to ask.

social.title: Rooftop Cocktails at Mamba Negra
social.description: Sip cocktails at the El Poblado rooftop ranked 22nd on The World's 50 Best Bars 2026.
social.bonus: Ask the bartender to make you something off-menu based on your favourite fruit.

social.title: Tejo Night at Unidad Deportiva José René Higuita
social.description: Hurl metal pucks at gunpowder targets on the renovated public courts and play Colombia's explosive national sport.
social.bonus: Make a mecha explode on your first throw or buy the next round of snacks.

social.title: Christmas Alumbrados Along Parques del Río
social.description: Stroll with the whole city through millions of Christmas lights strung along the Medellín River.
social.bonus: Share a natilla and buñuelo with your group under the brightest display.

social.title: Milongas at the Festival Internacional de Tango
social.description: Join free concerts and street milongas as Medellín honours Carlos Gardel, who died in the city in 1935.
social.bonus: Dance at least one tango in public, even if badly.

social.title: Salsa Class at Dancefree
social.description: Learn paisa salsa in a drop-in group class, then stay for the practice session to test your moves.
social.bonus: Rotate partners at least five times during the practice hour.

social.title: Aguardiente Round at El Social in Provenza
social.description: Grab a plastic chair at the old corner tienda that became Provenza's most iconic hangout, with salsa and chicharrón.
social.bonus: Order a round of aguardiente for the table next to yours.

social.title: Atlético Nacional Match at Estadio Atanasio Girardot
social.description: Wear green and white and sing with the south stand as Colombia's most decorated club plays at home.
social.bonus: Learn the words to one chant before kickoff and belt it out.

social.title: Silleteros Parade at the Feria de las Flores
social.description: Cheer as hundreds of flower farmers parade giant silletas on their backs at the city's biggest party of the year.
social.bonus: Get a photo with a silletero and their flower arrangement.

social.title: Craft Beer at 3 Cordilleras Estación Central
social.description: Drink fresh pints and catch live music in the old brewing plant where Medellín's craft beer scene began.
social.bonus: Order a flight and rank the beers blind.

culture.title: Graffiti and Escalators of Comuna 13
culture.description: Ride the open-air escalators through a once-feared barrio now covered in murals, hip hop and street dance.
culture.bonus: Buy a mango biche from a local vendor and tip the street dancers.

culture.title: Reflection at Museo Casa de la Memoria
culture.description: Walk through moving testimony of Colombia's armed conflict in a free museum built for remembrance.
culture.bonus: Write a message on the memory wall before you leave.

culture.title: A Show at Teatro Pablo Tobón Uribe
culture.description: Catch theatre, music or dance at the historic 1967 playhouse at the top of Avenida La Playa.
culture.bonus: Pick the show by pointing blindly at the monthly programme.

culture.title: Botero Sculptures and Museo de Antioquia
culture.description: Meet 23 voluptuous Botero bronzes in the plaza, then see the master's paintings in the museum he filled with his gifts.
culture.bonus: Recreate the pose of your favourite statue for a photo.

culture.title: Exhibitions at the Museo de Arte Moderno de Medellín
culture.description: Explore Débora Arango's daring work and new Colombian art inside a converted steel foundry in Ciudad del Río.
culture.bonus: Pick the one piece you would hang at home and defend your choice to the group.

culture.title: Pueblito Paisa on Cerro Nutibara
culture.description: Climb to a replica Antioquian village on a hilltop in the middle of the city for church bells and panoramic views.
culture.bonus: Buy a traditional carriel or poncho souvenir and wear it for the rest of the day.

culture.title: Gardens and Halls of Museo El Castillo
culture.description: Tour a 1930s Gothic-style castle full of European art and stroll its manicured French gardens in El Poblado.
culture.bonus: Find the oldest object in the house and guess its age before reading the label.

culture.title: Cross the Puente de Occidente
culture.description: Walk an 1895 suspension bridge over the Cauca River, then wander the cobbled colonial streets of Santa Fe de Antioquia.
culture.bonus: Stop at the middle of the bridge and shout your group's name into the canyon.

8ball.title: Sanalejo Market Treasure Hunt in Parque Bolívar
8ball.description: On the first Saturday of the month, dive into hundreds of artisan stalls with a wildcard mission from the group.
8ball.bonus: Each person gets COP 30,000 to buy a gift for someone else in the group, revealed only at the end.

8ball.title: Metro Line A End to End Dare
8ball.description: Ride the Metro from Niquía to La Estrella and hop off at whichever station the group's dice roll chooses.
8ball.bonus: At the chosen stop, eat whatever the first street vendor outside the station sells.

adventure.title: Salto del Buey Waterfall Canyon
adventure.description: Hike down into the canyon below one of Antioquia's most powerful waterfalls, a thundering drop of about 90 metres.
adventure.bonus: Get close enough to the spray that everyone leaves soaked.

adventure.title: Sunrise Hike Up Cerro de las Tres Cruces
adventure.description: Join the dawn crowd of locals powering up a steep hill to three crosses and a city skyline glowing at your feet.
adventure.bonus: Do ten push-ups at the top beside the crosses.

adventure.title: Cloud Forest Hike at Parque Ecológico La Romera
adventure.description: Climb a quiet protected forest above Sabaneta where locals go to escape the city on weekends.
adventure.bonus: Do the last stretch in total silence and listen for the birds.

adventure.title: Sunday Ciclovía Ride on Avenida El Poblado
adventure.description: Join thousands of cyclists, runners and skaters when the city closes its main avenues to cars on Sunday mornings.
adventure.bonus: Stop for a fresh orange juice from a street cart and toast a stranger.

adventure.title: Climb the 740 Steps of Piedra del Peñol
adventure.description: Zigzag up the staircase stitched into a 200 metre granite monolith for a view over a maze of emerald islands.
adventure.bonus: Count every step out loud as a group and celebrate at the top with a michelada or lulo juice.

adventure.title: Tandem Paragliding Over San Félix
adventure.description: Run off a green ridge in San Félix and float with a certified pilot above the whole Aburrá Valley.
adventure.bonus: Film a ten second mid-air message to your future self.

adventure.title: Hike to Cerro Cristo Rey Above Jardín
adventure.description: Climb to the Christ statue on the hill over Jardín for a view of the colourful town wrapped in coffee slopes.
adventure.bonus: Find the basilica's spire from the top and take a photo lining it up with your thumb.

adventure.title: Metrocable Ride Into Parque Arví
adventure.description: Ride the Metrocable over the hillside barrios and up into a cloud forest of pine and oak trails high above the city.
adventure.bonus: Buy a fruit snack at the Arví farmers' stalls and eat it on the trail without phones out.

adventure.title: Summit Cerro Quitasol
adventure.description: Tackle the steep pyramid peak above Bello for the biggest bragging-rights view in the valley.
adventure.bonus: Pack an arepa for the summit and share it with another hiking group.

adventure.title: Source of the River at Alto de San Miguel
adventure.description: Trek into the protected cloud forest in Caldas where the Río Medellín is born as a clear mountain stream.
adventure.bonus: Dip your hand in the river at its source and again in the city on the way home.

adventure.title: Trail Loop on Cerro El Volador
adventure.description: Hike the city's biggest urban nature park, a hill once sacred to the Aburrá people, for a 360 degree view.
adventure.bonus: Spot and photograph three different bird species before you reach the summit.

adventure.title: Forest Trails at Parque Ecológico Piedras Blancas
adventure.description: Walk misty reservoir trails and a butterfly garden in the highlands of Santa Elena.
adventure.bonus: Find and photograph a butterfly that lands on someone in your group.

adventure.title: Ride La Garrucha Over Jardín
adventure.description: Dangle in a tiny wooden cart on a cable built for hauling coffee, swinging over a valley to a hilltop trail.
adventure.bonus: Wave at the first coffee farmer you see below.

adventure.title: Rafting and Caving at Reserva Río Claro
adventure.description: Float a turquoise river through a white marble canyon, then wade into a cave full of oilbirds.
adventure.bonus: Let the current carry you downstream on your back for one full minute.

adventure.title: Guatapé Reservoir Boat Ride From the Malecón
adventure.description: Cruise the island-studded reservoir past the cross marking the drowned old town of El Peñol.
adventure.bonus: Convince the captain to let you pick the boat's next song.

adventure.title: Cueva del Esplendor Waterfall Hike
adventure.description: Jeep and hike into the cloud forest above Jardín to a cave where a waterfall crashes through the roof.
adventure.bonus: Stand in the plunge pool under the spray for a full ten seconds.
